verdict.rationale: Rive's runtimes are documented as open-source libraries, and the rive-runtime GitHub repo exposes readable source for loading .riv files and rendering. Community comments note the MIT license covers only the runtime/rendering layer, while the Editor, where content is built, is proprietary and paid. So only part of the product's source is open. Missing for 10: open-source Editor, first-party documentation of the specific license terms, and the full product source rather than just the runtime.
